note: Majority: Civil Code of Georgia, Article 12, in the English text WIPO Lex holds: full legal capacity arises at majority, and a person of majority is one who has attained eighteen; marriage before eighteen gives capacity (not held). sources.title: WIPO Lex, Civil Code of Georgia (English)
sources.said: (legal capacity) shall arise upon the attainment of the age of majority. 2. A person of the age of majority – an adult – is one who has attained the age of eighteen years.
